image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, leafless branch against a clear blue sky. The bird exhibits the plumage characteristics of a non-breeding male or female, with a greyish-brown head and back, and a pale orange-rufous breast and belly. It has a short, conical, yellowish-grey bill and dark eyes. The wings are folded, showing dark feathers with subtle white edging. The legs are slender and pinkish-brown, gripping the branch firmly.
